purpose: GEARS GO-graph / gene2go resources for the deep-baseline gears_worker; pre-acquired in dev-pod Phase 0 and content-pinned by SHA-256 so the sealed run never downloads at fit time.

acquisition.method: GEARS 0.1.2 baked-in loaders (gears.pertdata.PertData.load / gears.utils.get_similarity_network), which fetch from Harvard Dataverse

license_note: Underlying NCBI gene2go is a U.S. Government work (public domain); Gene Ontology annotations are CC BY 4.0. Files here are the GEARS project's redistributed Harvard Dataverse snapshots (dataset DOI landing page is authoritative for the redistribution license). The SHA-256 below is the immutable content identity used for reproducibility; exact dataset-DOI license text = confirm on the Dataverse page if a redistribution-license record is required.

resources.name: gene2go_all.pkl
resources.role: gene->GO term mapping used to build the GEARS GO similarity graph

resources.name: essential_all_data_pert_genes.pkl
resources.role: essential perturbation-gene set for GEARS GO-graph restriction

resources.name: go_essential_all
resources.role: precomputed GO-essential edge list (perturbation-gene GO similarity graph); datafile/6934319 serves a .tar.gz that GEARS extracts to a .csv
